details.label: Annotation workflow
details.value: The team retained existing organ labels and used single-organ models to initialize missing structures. Fifteen junior annotators corrected axial segmentations in ITK-SNAP under two board-certified radiologists. A senior abdominal radiologist reviewed the labels and rechecked low-scoring cases identified by cross-validation.

details.label: Core archive layout
details.value: The three ZIP member lists contain compressed NIfTI image files named Case_XXXXX_0000.nii.gz. Part 3 also supplies the public annotations in Mask.7z and explains how hidden references are evaluated.

details.label: Acquisition
details.value: The study includes different vendors, contrast phases, and diseases. In the Nanjing cohort, GE CT acquisitions included 18 noncontrast, 18 arterial-phase, and 14 portal-phase scans with 512 × 512 in-plane matrices and 1.25–5 mm slice thickness.

details.label: Variation in scan geometry
details.value: Supplementary Table 1 gives slice counts and thickness by source cohort. Across the reported cohorts, slice thickness ranges from 0.5 to 8.0 mm.

details.label: Benchmark interpretation
details.value: The four training protocols reuse source scans. Each has its own 100-scan test cohort selected for challenging and randomly sampled cases, plus the common 50-scan Nanjing evaluation. The paper uses Dice similarity and normalized surface Dice at 1 mm.

details.label: Public masks
details.value: The authors withheld some reference masks to protect benchmark evaluation. Their release note directs users to the four challenge evaluation sites.

details.label: Pseudo-tumor update
details.value: The authors added 110 cases to the initial 663-case pseudo-label release. The updated archive covers 773 core scans.

details.label: Core citation
details.value: The authors request citation of the 2022 IEEE journal article. The bibliography also includes separate Zenodo DOIs for each distributed image part and benchmark.

details.label: Release date and version
details.value: Zenodo labels the three core image parts v1 and dates them July 27, 2021. The Zenodo records were created on January 26, 2022. The FLARE22 extension has a separate release and version.

details.label: FLARE22 attribution
details.value: The labeled extension asks users to credit both the AbdomenCT-1K article and the Medical Segmentation Decathlon dataset description by Simpson and colleagues.

details.label: LiTS attribution
details.value: The challenge requests citation of its website and benchmark publication and asks users to notify the organizers of work based on its data.

details.label: NIH component citation
details.value: TCIA requires a citation to Data From Pancreas-CT for use of the original collection and supplies the corresponding publications on its collection page.

details.value: Five clinicians contributed records from 2022 to 2025. The 463 patients were 18 to 90 years old, with a median age of 54 years.

details.label: Files
details.value: Panoramic radiographs are 8-bit grayscale PNG, 1722 × 922 pixels. Each language archive contains 463 UTF-8 JSON records, a manifest, and rater and identifier audit tables.

details.label: Label coverage
details.value: The 17 fields include nine structured and eight narrative fields. Twenty-eight distinct ICD-10 code atoms are represented, with more than one code in 127 records. The codes generally have category-level precision.

details.label: Pairing
details.value: The English copy translates narrative fields. Both copies contain the same images and structured fields. Fourteen radiographs were unlinked during the version 3 de-identification review, and six were unavailable at collection.

details.label: Annotation process
details.value: Four thoracic radiologists marked scans independently, then reviewed their findings alongside the other anonymized marks. Readers could retain differing opinions.

details.label: Target interpretation
details.value: Radiologist nodule contours describe morphology. The separate diagnostic spreadsheet identifies benign, primary malignant or metastatic disease for a limited subset, at patient level or nodule level when available.

details.label: Annotation granularity
details.value: Volumetric boundaries and characteristic ratings apply to nodules of at least 3 mm. Smaller nodules and larger non-nodule findings use point marks.

details.label: Correlated labels
details.value: The standardized annotation release reproduces reader-level delineations as separate DICOM objects. Counts of annotations or structured reports cannot measure the number of patients.

details.label: Release history
details.value: The cohort paper appeared in 2011. The original release citation uses 2015. TCIA dates its version 4 inventory to September 2020.

details.label: Classification cohort
details.value: TCIA reports diagnosis for a limited number of subjects. The complete imaging cohort size does not represent the number with diagnostic ground truth.

details.label: Cohort and assay overlap
details.value: 201 participants contributed 294 tumour samples to the primary molecular cohort. Multiple tumour regions were sampled for 41 participants. Assay counts overlap, and only the explicitly co-assayed subsets identify paired molecular measurements.

details.label: Processed data scope
details.value: Some harmonized Zenodo matrices also contain previously published comparison cohorts, multiregional specimens and technical replicates. Their column totals exceed the number of newly enrolled participants.

details.label: Clinical information
details.value: The clinical overview and data dictionary describe sample-level clinical, histological and technical fields. Some values are missing and treatment information was not collected; no complete-case count for survival is established here.

details.label: Molecular and imaging tasks
details.value: Integrative analysis identified four archetypes. The slide classifier evaluated Ca A1, Ca A2 and Ca B; the supra-carcinoid-enriched group had too few slides for image-model training. Tile clustering and expert tissue attributes describe morphology. A molecular label on a slide does not establish which raw assays are available for that participant.

details.label: Imaging and annotation files
details.value: The BioImage Archive hosts H&E/HES slides acquired at 40× on a Leica Aperio AT2. Zenodo hosts WSI_metadata_Pathologist_labels.xlsx and WSI_annotations.xlsx, which includes tile centroids and morphological attributes.

details.label: Spatial protein cohort discrepancy
details.value: Zenodo v1.1 reports 64 participants and 513 areas of interest. The online descriptor abstract reports 67 participants; Methods lists 67 and 549 areas, including three supra-carcinoid-enriched cases. The paper’s quality-control analysis uses 513 areas, and its Limitations says that group was excluded from DSP. The exact relationship of the three cases to the released matrices remains unresolved.

details.label: Raw and processed cohort sizes
details.value: For processed RNA and methylation, the descriptor reports 178 and 191 participants. The corresponding controlled EGA accessions list 179 and 181. The case counts refer to each source’s stated cohort or deposit.

details.label: Component versions
details.value: Zenodo identifies the processed-data deposit as v1.1. The whole-slide and Visium repositories use separate study accessions, S-BIAD3143 and E-MTAB-17055.

unresolved: The 64-person Zenodo spatial proteomics release and the 67-person count in the article have different reported scopes; whether all three additional participants are represented in any released DSP matrix is unclear.
The 109 participants reported with RNA-seq and methylation are described alongside 60 with all three assays. The descriptor does not explicitly give the inclusive RNA–methylation intersection.
The authors do not supply a complete-case count for clinical outcomes or for each specific bulk assay paired to a whole-slide image.
The ArrayExpress record has no explicit record-specific data license. A general BioStudies policy exists, and the Zenodo license is specific to the Zenodo deposit.

details.label: Label quality
details.value: A primary annotator proofread each volume slice by slice after model assistance or import from upstream. A second annotator independently reviewed one volume per subset. Mean instance F1 was 0.93 on those eight volumes.

details.label: Formats
details.value: Compressed NIfTI images and integer instance masks, companion OME-Zarr multiscale copies, nnU-Net descriptors, split files and optional ROI validity masks.

details.label: Resolution
details.value: FIB-SEM is standardized to 16 nm isotropic spacing. Serial-section and serial block-face SEM retain 8 × 8 × 30 nm spacing.

details.label: Coverage
details.value: The paper counts 28 volumes and 8,114 annotated mitochondria across the eight subsets. Crops overlap with the upstream datasets and should be considered when constructing external benchmarks.

details.label: Specimen discrepancies
details.value: The paper describes ME2-Sperm as Drosophila spermatocytes and ME2-Stem as mouse brainstem. Zenodo metadata.csv lists human epididymis sperm and human bone marrow stem cells, respectively.

details.label: Semantic features
details.value: The AIM XML encodes radiologist observations on 190 subjects. The segmentation series index counts 144 patients with 3D masks.

details.label: Molecular coverage
details.value: The authors report RNA sequencing for 130 subjects. Molecular assays, clinical records and image annotations cover different subsets.

details.label: Release history
details.value: The main TCIA record expands an earlier 26-person Stanford pilot. Version 4 is dated June 1, 2021.

details.label: Molecular subset overlap
details.value: The expression assays overlap for 17 people. The CT tumour-mask cohort, semantic-feature cohort and molecular cohorts have different denominators. The original study reports imaging-based EGFR/KRAS mutation prediction.

details.label: Source cohort
details.value: WU-Minn HCP Young Adult S1200. The original 3 T Siemens Skyra protocol acquired 0.7 mm isotropic T1-weighted MPRAGE and 1.25 mm multi-shell diffusion MRI.

details.label: Released files
details.value: The registered T1-weighted image and binary mask for each subject share a 1.25 mm isotropic grid.

details.label: Formats
details.value: NIfTI volumes and masks with subject-level CSV metadata. The CSV records anatomical measurements and image-quality summaries.

details.label: Annotation method
details.value: Expert tractography seeded model development. The authors applied inference across the release cohort, visually reviewed every mask, and edited 20 cases. The masks combine the three target structures into one class.

details.label: Evaluation
details.value: The paper reports five-fold cross-validation within a 131-subject development pool and a separate 20-subject test set. These counts describe the supervised baseline.

details.label: Applicability
details.value: The release covers healthy young adults imaged using a research protocol. Performance in diseased visual pathways and routine clinical acquisitions calls for separate evaluation.

details.label: Dataset citation
details.value: The DOI linked by BALSA identifies the Science Data Bank dataset record, registered as V2. The journal article has its own DOI.

details.label: Diffusion MRI linkage
details.value: Original HCP multi-shell diffusion images used to derive the annotations are accessed separately through ConnectomeDB. Subject identifiers in the release support linkage.

details.label: Full challenge and current release
details.value: The challenge included 108 labeled patients. The public release contains 50 labeled training patients, 8 preliminary test patients and 30 final test patients. The other 20 final test patients belong to cohort D.

details.label: Source of public counts
details.value: The counts of 50, 8, and 30 are patient directories in the three labeled folders at revision 7ba0723. The folders have disjoint patient identifiers.

details.label: Acquisition
details.value: Six international centres acquired sagittal 2D cine MRI during radiotherapy on 0.35 T ViewRay MRIdian or 1.5 T Elekta Unity MRI-linacs.

details.label: Released files
details.value: MetaImage (.mha) time series and masks are accompanied by JSON metadata for field strength, frame rate, and imaged region. The in-plane resolution was resampled to 1 × 1 mm.

details.label: Annotation protocol
details.value: Human observers delineated targets, and an additional reviewer checked and corrected the labels. Some cases contain multiple independent sets of contours.

details.label: Version history
details.value: The dataset DOI was registered in 2025. The current card documents a January 2026 expansion of public test data. The short version string identifies the inspected repository revision.
